Third-party code in Qt 6.8.3

The Qt 6.8.3 modules that RotorLab GC ships (Windows and Android) contain
the third-party code below. This list is generated from the SPDX software
bills of materials that The Qt Company ships with Qt 6.8.3 (the sbom
folder of each Qt kit). Test-only code, build-time tools and code for
platforms GC is not built for are left out. Standard license texts are
in the licenses/ folder (file name = SPDX id); license texts that have no
SPDX id are in the LicenseRef-*.txt files next to this one.
See also https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.8/licenses-used-in-qt.html.
